Veil_Sorceress.description: A fragile yet terrifying female caster who tears raw, chaotic power directly from the Veil. Only human and elven women can wield active Veil magic. The power is immense — the price is always higher than you think.
Veil_Sorceress.lore: When Eve’s daughters rejected the Maker’s gift, some chose to drink from the rift instead. They became the first Veil Sorceresses — living conduits between the world and the whispering chaos beyond. Their magic is not a tool. It is a lover that never stops demanding more. Many begin as brilliant, ambitious women. Most end as Hollowed — beautiful empty shells that still walk, talk, and smile while something else looks out through their eyes.

mastery_system.description: Repeated use of the same spell grants permanent mastery bonuses. These are small, flavorful, and never game-breaking. Mastery is tracked per spell.

bonuses_per_uses.100_uses: Corruption cost reduced by 2 + small efficiency bonus
bonuses_per_uses.200_uses: Corruption cost reduced by 3 + +1 to spell effect (e.g. +1 die, +5% duration, etc.)

corruption_system.mitigation: Willpower save (once per long rest) can halve gain

thresholds.50: Minor physical changes, intrusive whispers, occasional loss of short-term memory
thresholds.75: Major behavioral changes, blackouts, friends begin to notice 'something is wrong'
thresholds.90: The Veil begins to speak with your voice. You sometimes act without deciding to
thresholds.100: Hollowed — the character is no longer yours. She becomes an NPC under GM control

corruption_system.flavor: Corruption is never shown on the character sheet. It is felt in play.

progression.name: Ascendant (or Hollowed)
progression.special: At this point the GM may begin secretly rolling for loss of control.

Fade_Step.mastery_note: Repeated use reduces corruption to 1 at 100 uses

Blood_Pact.effect: Sacrifice 8 HP for +20% spell power 3 rounds

Shroud_Slip.effect: Become nearly invisible for 1 round while moving

Echo_of_Eve.effect: Once per scene, when you would take lethal damage, spend 20 stamina and 12 corruption to survive at 1 HP

Veil_Apotheosis.effect: Once per campaign, become one with the Veil for 3 rounds — godlike power, but permanent +30 corruption at the end

Hollowing_Begins.description: The Veil slowly takes the wheel. You become a passenger in your own body.

Hollowed.description: The character is no longer fully yours. GM may take control at any time.
